abstention: if any symbol lacks a candidate score, that candidate records no targets for the day; its previous weights are held and the day is excluded from its risk-policy history

ensemble_tilt.definition: static V0 ensemble: fsum(w_i * score_i) with w_i = 1/3 over quorum.momentum, quorum.trend, quorum.mean_reversion; abstains when any member abstains

equal_weight_control.definition: equal-weight fully-invested control: score 0 for every symbol gives tilt 0.5, so proposed weight 0.5 * (2/N) = 1/N per symbol (0.125 for N = 8) and gross N * 1/N = 1.0, within the cap. From all cash the 0.5 turnover cap halves the first decision (0.0625 each, gross 0.5); the second reaches 0.125 each, gross 1.0. It is rebalanced back to 1/N at every valid execution from its drifted weights, paying costs on the actual trades, exactly like every other candidate

trend_tilt.definition: quorum.trend score (SMA10 vs SMA50) used directly

vol_regime_tilt.definition: quorum.volatility_regime score used directly; the one confirmatory hypothesis

always_reported.sharpe_difference_annualized: observed Sharpe(vol_regime_tilt) - Sharpe(equal_weight_control) from daily moments (mean / population std), times sqrt(252)
always_reported.studentized_statistic: T = daily Sharpe difference / its Newey-West HAC delta-method standard error

confirmatory_test.hypothesis: the preregistered volatility-regime tilt improves prospective risk-adjusted performance relative to the equal-weight fully-invested control

method.name: Ledoit-Wolf (2008) studentized circular block bootstrap
method.series: paired daily open-to-open returns over the common span
method.standard_error: delta method on moments (a, b, a^2, b^2) with a Newey-West (Bartlett) HAC, lag = block length

confirmatory_test.n_definition: number of paired daily open-to-open returns of vol_regime_tilt and equal_weight_control over their common evaluation span
confirmatory_test.power_note: simulated power at 2 years and 0.95 correlation is about 22% for a true +0.2 annual Sharpe gain and about 59% for +0.5, so not_supported is not evidence of no effect
confirmatory_test.reporting_rule: all always_reported fields appear in every evaluation, including interim and insufficient_observations ones; interim values are descriptive only; statistic fields are null only when the bootstrap cannot run (fewer than two blocks)
confirmatory_test.uncertainty: the procedure produces no confidence interval; it also reports standard_error_daily, the HAC delta-method standard error of the daily Sharpe difference

corporate_actions: provider adjustment only; evaluation reads opens from the most recent decision's snapshot, so dividends count as return and splits are continuous

costs.application: each valid execution pays rate * sum_i |target_i - pre_trade_i| of pre-trade equity, where pre_trade_i are the drifted weights (L1 turnover of the actual trades); targets are fractions of post-cost equity

data.loader_bar_validation: validate_ohlc: high/low excursions <= 1e-9 relative are snapped; genuine OHLC violations are dropped by the loader
data.price_adjustment: provider auto_adjust=True: OHLC adjusted for splits and dividends; volume split-adjusted
data.snapshot: each decision's input bars are a content-addressed snapshot it references

metrics: annualized_volatility = sample std of daily returns * sqrt(252)
sharpe = mean / sample std of daily returns * sqrt(252), zero risk-free
max_drawdown of the daily equity curve
avg_gross_exposure and avg_cash_weight, averaged over daily post-trade marks
vs_control: daily excess mean (annualized), t, tracking error, information ratio
evaluation.series: daily open-to-open returns from the first valid execution's open to the last observed open, identical dates for every candidate
evaluation.status: interim until the New York date passes end_date; interim results are descriptive only and cannot alter this study

execution.fill: open of the first bar after the decision bar (next session open, 09:30 New York)
execution.holding: between valid executions each position drifts with its own open-to-open price and cash earns 0; at each valid execution the portfolio trades from its drifted pre-trade weights to the targets
execution.late_rule: a decision counts only if recorded_at < that bar's start; a late decision never counts and the previous weights are held
execution.marking: every candidate is marked to market at every session open
execution.orders: hypothetical only; no broker and no order path

external_reference.name: SPY.US buy and hold
external_reference.rule: descriptive only and never part of the confirmatory test: bought at the first valid execution's open paying the declared rate once, then held and marked daily; omitted if SPY.US is not in the universe

horizon.concurrency: materially changed systems receive new study IDs and may run concurrently; this study is never modified
horizon.rule: no run is accepted after end_date (New York date); no early stopping for performance; the final evaluation is the first after end_date
horizon.start: the first decision recorded after declaration

information_cutoff.decision_bar: the latest bar closed for every symbol
information_cutoff.recorded_at: the actual run time; never backdated
information_cutoff.rule: a bar is used only if its close (event_at) <= recorded_at, the run's wall clock
information_cutoff.unclosed_bars: excluded and counted in the decision record

initial_state.ramp: the turnover cap limits target gross to 0.5 after the first decision; the control reaches 1.0 at the second

missed_runs.catch_up: a later run decides only the latest closed session, never backdates, and is late if it runs after the next open
missed_runs.reporting: every session after the first decision without a decision is listed as missed
missed_runs.rule: a session with no decision has none; the previous weights are held

missing_data.calendar_mismatch: a 'skip' when the symbols' latest 253 closed sessions differ
missing_data.fetch_or_validation_failure: the run appends a 'skip' record with the reason; no decision
missing_data.missing_values: any NaN in a fetched bar fails the run as a 'skip'

non_trading_days: a run with no newly closed session appends nothing and returns 'no_new_session' (weekends, holidays, repeated runs)

operations.note: scheduling never affects validity; recorded_at and the late rule decide
operations.schedule: weekdays 17:00 America/Denver, and as soon as possible after a missed start

risk.rules: gross above the cap scales all weights proportionally; then L1 turnover above the cap interpolates proportionally from the previous executable targets; no leverage, no shorts; the remainder is cash
risk.state: replayed each run over the candidate's full recorded score history
risk.targets_vs_trades: the policy is price-unaware, as in research: its turnover cap limits changes between successive targets, while actual trades run from drifted pre-trade weights to the targets and may differ

universe.membership: fixed for the whole study; nothing added, removed, or replaced
universe.selection_note: large US ETFs and stocks chosen in 2026: survivorship-selected
